name: Azel
message: 「What is the point of celebrating a temporary day?」

name: Azel
message: 「To begin with, this is not the day I was born」

name: Azel
message: 「You ask when my true birthday is?」

name: Azel
message: 「I suppose I could find out if I looked into it, though I do not know」

name: Azel
message: 「What meaning would there be in knowing?」
